Tate McRae vs Sabrina Carpenter by the numbers (Spotify, as of Oct 20, 2026): Tate's catalog adds 13.8M streams a day to Sabrina's 12.6M, and her new single "Housewife" (out Oct 15) is #1 in the US, UK, Canada, Australia and worldwide.

Sabrina still leads on listeners, 53.7M vs 43.0M, and has six songs past 1B streams (Tate has two).

Who owns 2026 pop? 👇
